summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj, a Finnish foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq Helsinki, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a stock exchange release dated October 5, 2026, announcing a change to its interim report publication date for the January-September 2026 period, now set for Thursday, November 5, 2026, versus the previously stated Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The release provides only investor-relations contact details and a company description; no transaction, shareholder action, or structural event is disclosed. This is a routine scheduling notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
